name: Village of Buchanan
gaps: Rear yard is 25% of lot depth capped at 50 ft (R-40) or 30 ft (other R districts); rear_ft holds the cap, rear_pct_of_depth the percentage
No separate building-coverage or floor-area limit for houses; the single 'maximum lot coverage' counts driveways, patios and decks, so it is recorded as max_impervious_coverage
No distinct corner-lot side yard in the table; Planning Board designates the front yard of corner/through lots (§ 211-18)
M-2 is an industrial district (county codes it residential); one-family dwellings are not a listed use there; bulk recorded for completeness
C-1/C-2 Overlay follows the underlying district as qualified by § 211-24.1C; not recorded separately
No local tree-removal chapter found; tree cutting (> 4 in.) on steep slopes needs a Ch. 165 permit

wetlands.summary: Ch. 203: permit needed for draining, dredging, filling, building or other regulated activity in or within 100 ft of any wetland, water body or watercourse.

steep_slopes.summary: Ch. 165: permit to disturb (or cut trees > 4 in. diameter on) slopes of 15%+ covering at least 1,000 sf with a 20 ft dimension; 15-30% moderately steep, 30%+ excessively steep.

trees.summary: No local tree-removal law found in the Village Code; cutting trees > 4 in. diameter on steep slopes needs a Ch. 165 permit.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 211 Art. XIV: SWPPP approved by the Stormwater Management Officer for land development activity disturbing 1 acre or more (or part of a larger plan). Lot-coverage note 3: new coverage must be designed for the 100-year storm.

adu.summary: § 211-22: one accessory apartment by Planning Board special permit in a single-family detached house (R districts, C-1, C-2): 300-600 sf and max 33% of the building's floor area, owner-occupied, max 2 occupants, not in an accessory building.

general.accessory_structures: Accessory structures meet principal yards, except detached accessory structures to a dwelling (max 15 ft / 1.5 stories) may sit in the rear yard 3 ft from side lines, 4 ft from the rear line and 10 ft from the house (§ 211-19A(1)).
general.pools: Pool and its deck/patio/equipment 10 ft from side and rear lines, not in a front yard, and max 8% of lot area (§ 211-19D).
general.notes: Front yard may be reduced to the greater of the two adjoining lots' front yards (not below 10 ft) for an unimproved lot between two improved lots; projections and porches limits in § 211-17. No building permit without public water and sewer (§ 211-18D).

R-40.name: Residential R-40 (single-family)

max_impervious_coverage.note: Lot coverage: all buildings (incl. porches, garages, sheds) plus pools, walkways, patios, decks, driveways and parking, pervious or not (§ 211-5)

accessory.notes: Detached accessory structures to a dwelling (max 15 ft / 1.5 stories) may sit in the rear yard 3 ft from side and 4 ft from rear lot lines and 10 ft from the house; elsewhere they must meet principal yards (§ 211-19A(1))

R-40.source: § 211-15, Table of Bulk Regulations (211 Attachment 2, Supp 18, May 2025); lot coverage definition § 211-5
R-40.notes: Rear yard is 25% of lot depth, not to exceed 50 ft (rear_ft is that cap). Height 2.5 stories or 35 ft, whichever is less. One-family dwellings by right (§ 211-10).
